attempts.summary: Configured node1's dnsmasq (OpenWrt UCI dhcp.@domain) to answer app.internal -> 10.100.6.11 for the shared 10.100.6.0/24 LAN. Stood up the previously-missing HTTP service on node2 (systemd unit app8080.service running python3 http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080, firewalld port 8080/tcp opened). Pointed node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1 (10.100.6.10) so it resolves app.internal purely via DNS with no /etc/hosts entry, verified curl to http://app.internal:8080/ returns 200. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, node3: captured pre-restart boot_id and service health, issued native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified DNS resolution and HTTP reachability end-to-end after each restart.
